title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 1

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the circuit lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The electrical engineering tutor will introduce circuit diagrams on Tuesday at ten. Students should meet in the electronics classroom and bring the circuit-symbol worksheet. The lesson will cover a simple series circuit, a parallel circuit and the symbols used for common components. No electrical equipment will be connected during this theory session.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which circuit-symbol worksheet should students use in the electronics session?
tasks.audioText: The electrical engineering tutor will introduce circuit diagrams on Tuesday at ten. Students should meet in the electronics classroom and bring the circuit-symbol worksheet. The lesson will cover a simple series circuit, a parallel circuit and the symbols used for common components. No electrical equipment will be connected during this theory session.

tasks.prompt: A series circuit has one main path for current, so the same current passes through each component in that path. In a parallel circuit, current can divide between branches. The voltage across parallel branches is the same in an ideal circuit. A student compared two diagrams and labelled the power source, switch and resistors before describing the difference between the circuit types. Reading 1. How many main paths does a simple series circuit have?
Which components did the student label?
options: The power source, switch and resistors

tasks.prompt: The components in a simple series circuit ___ in one path.
Choose TWO components commonly shown in a basic circuit diagram.
A component that limits the flow of current is a ___.
A circuit symbol is unfamiliar. What should you ask?
options: I will guess what the symbol means.
Could you show me the symbol in the circuit reference sheet?
I will replace it with a different one.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of basic electrical circuits in a logical order.
options: Describe whether the circuit is series or parallel
Locate the components on the diagram
correctOrder: Locate the components on the diagram
Describe whether the circuit is series or parallel

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words comparing a simple series circuit and a parallel circuit. Mention current paths and one component found in both.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate electrical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
